solution_title: Hyperlocal Weather, Air Quality, Pollen & Solar Dashboard
summary: Cohesive Phase 2 Shared Solution Architecture Blueprint for the Hyperlocal Weather, Air Quality, Pollen & Solar Dashboard pre-seeded in Downtown Phoenix (Phoenix City Hall). Uses zero-deprecation Maps JS API v2 (2D Vector Map with mapId='DEMO_MAP_ID', AdvancedMarkerElement, PlaceAutocompleteElement with gmp-select, Place.searchByText, Geocoder for map-click reverse geocoding, and native ImageMapType for WebGL-free AQI heatmap tiles) paired with live Weather, Air Quality, Pollen, and Solar APIs—via direct browser calls on client-only stacks and secure /api/* BFF proxies with X-Goog-Api-Key and X-Goog-FieldMask on full-stack frameworks.
gmp_products_used: Maps JavaScript API (2D Vector Map, AdvancedMarkerElement, PinElement, ImageMapType, Polygon/Rectangle, Geocoder)
ui_layout_summary: Full-viewport split-screen dashboard with a 64px top header bar (app brand, PlaceAutocompleteElement search box, Phoenix preset reset, Imperial/Metric units toggle, AQI tile overlay toggle, and Roadmap/Hybrid satellite toggle) above a 2-column workspace: a 420px scrollable left Environmental Intelligence Sidebar (Location summary, Weather current + 5-day forecast, Air Quality Index + pollutants + health advice, Tree/Grass/Weed Pollen forecast, and Rooftop Solar Building Insights with graceful 404 non-coverage handling) paired with a full-height interactive 2D Google Map (min-height: 520px) featuring an AdvancedMarkerElement, building-click coordinate inspection, optional US_AQI ImageMapType overlay, and building bounding-box highlight.
interactive_controls: data-testid="places-autocomplete-container" (Hosts modern PlaceAutocompleteElement listening to gmp-select and calling event.placePrediction.toPlace().fetchFields())
data-testid="active-location-badge" (Displays active place/address and live lat/lng coordinates)
data-testid="reset-phoenix-btn" (Resets inspection target to pre-seeded Phoenix City Hall location)
data-testid="units-toggle-btn" (Toggles IMPERIAL vs METRIC units for Weather API and Solar/UI display)
data-testid="aqi-layer-toggle" (Toggles native google.maps.ImageMapType US_AQI raster tile overlay on map.overlayMapTypes without WebGL)
data-testid="map-type-toggle" (Switches base mapTypeId between roadmap and hybrid/satellite for rooftop visual inspection)
data-testid="environmental-sidebar" (Scrollable left intelligence panel housing all live environmental cards)
data-testid="selected-location-card" (Displays resolved place name, formatted address, coordinates, and click-building instruction)
data-testid="weather-card" (Displays live Weather API current conditions: temp, feels-like, humidity, UV, wind, precipitation)
data-testid="weather-forecast-list" (Displays 5-day daily forecast cards from Weather API forecast/days:lookup)
data-testid="air-quality-card" (Displays AQI index badge, category, dominant pollutant, pollutant concentrations, and health recommendations)
data-testid="pollen-card" (Displays Tree, Grass, and Weed UPI levels, in-season status, plant allergens, and health guidance)
data-testid="solar-card" (Displays Solar API maxArrayPanelsCount, array kW, maxSunshineHoursPerYear, roof area, carbon offset, or data-testid="solar-non-coverage" graceful fallback)
data-testid="map-container" (Interactive 2D Google Map with explicit >=520px height, mapId="DEMO_MAP_ID", AdvancedMarkerElement, and solar bounding box highlight)

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Proxy current real-time weather conditions from Weather API (currentConditions:lookup) for lat/lng coordinates with X-Goog-Api-Key and unitsSystem support.
Proxy 5-day daily weather forecast from Weather API (forecast/days:lookup) for lat/lng coordinates.
Proxy current AQI, local/universal indexes, pollutant concentrations, and demographic health recommendations from Air Quality API (currentConditions:lookup).
Proxy 256x256 PNG Air Quality heatmap tiles (US_AQI / UAQI_RED_GREEN) for the optional ImageMapType map overlay without exposing server API keys.
Proxy 3-to-5-day localized Tree, Grass, and Weed pollen index levels, allergen plant info, and health guidance from Pollen API (forecast:lookup).

Proxy rooftop solar panel capacity, annual sunshine hours, roof area, and carbon offset factor from Solar API (buildingInsights:findClosest), returning a clean 404/non-coverage JSON payload when no building is within 50m.
Server-side Places API (New) Text Search proxy for resolving the initial Phoenix seed_search_query on full-stack stacks with explicit X-Goog-FieldMask.
